role: District Representative · Muntinlupa City, Lone District
summary: Muntinlupa representative with 192 principal-authored bills. Authored the national minimum wage, higher GSIS survivorship pensions, higher retired-teacher pensions, a medical-product tax exemption in emergencies, equality in marriage and family law, and a party system strengthening bill with a subsidy fund.
caveat: Family-law equality and party subsidy are each a single issue and unscored. The extractor surfaced only 7 rubric bills of 192, so evidence may be incomplete.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored a national minimum wage (-2), higher GSIS survivorship and retired-teacher pensions (-2) and emergency tax exemption on medical products (-1).
